newsitem.title: USA: Protester arrested after descending from TV tower.
newsitem.headline: Protester arrested after descending from TV tower.

text.p: A 35-year-old Texan ended his protest in a 600-foot television tower Thursday, descending from his lofty perch after 36 hours only to be arrested by local police, local television reported.
The man, identified as Arlez Gomez of Texas, was scheduled to undergo a mental evaluation Friday, police said.
Gomez scaled the tower Wednesday, slung a hammock between its struts about 300 feet up and settled in with a cell phone, food and newspapers.
Police said he was protesting what he alleged was a false arrest and conviction as well as a dishonorable discharge from the Army.
Gomez is believed to have been involved in a similar incident in Killeen, Texas, in May 1996. It lasted three days.
